# Matthew "Forni" Fornaciari

> Personal site of Matthew "Forni" Fornaciari: growth engineer in Denver, Colorado. He runs Atelic (atelic.me), a one person growth practice for owner operated businesses. Before that: co-founder and CTO of Gremlin (est. 2016), where chaos engineering became a discipline; climate technology at QuitCarbon and Zero Homes; Amazon and Salesforce at the start. He writes essays at Atelic Action. Brown University, applied mathematics and computer science.

Ethos: been there before, happy to help. Reliability is how he builds; altruism is why.
